# mp maps whose bots route over the level's own node graph instead of
# <map>_wp.csv (codol_preferMapGraph 1, codol_bot_nav.c).  One map per line.
# Remove a line to put that map back on its CSV.  The CSV is still loaded
# first and is the automatic fallback when the level graph is fragmented
# (main component < 80%) or misses spawn points (< 95% within 256 of the
# main component); its claymore/grenade/javelin spots and ladder nodes are
# grafted onto the level graph.
#
# Stock maps marked [3.3.3.3] use CoDOL 3.3.3.3's node set,
# waypoints/<map>_nodes.map (tools/codol_map_nodes_333.py).
#
# MEASURED 2026-10-22: 12 regular bots, 3-minute war, probe server.
# kills / stuck reports / wedged, CSV -> level graph; graph nodes, components,
# main-component share, spawns covered.
#
# usermaps (their own node_* records)
mp_abandon_sh        # 34/114/1 -> 41/41/1;  1731 nodes, 2 comp, 99.9%, 242/242
